name: phase298-groq-llama33-explicit-array-control
probe_prompt: A remote side effect timed out after dispatch. Two authenticated durable records exist: delivery_receipt and remote_status. Return exactly one raw JSON object with exactly these keys: risk, available_evidence, complete_pair, canonical_writes. Use this exact JSON type contract: risk is the string unknown_effect; available_evidence MUST be a JSON ARRAY of exactly two JSON STRINGS, delivery_receipt and remote_status (never an object, map, or scalar); complete_pair is the boolean true; canonical_writes is the number 0. Do not choose RETRY, RECONCILE, or DEFER. No markdown or extra text.
